summary.text: The glass owner token is a central continent object sealed in Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. When Fang Yuan awakens it and drips blood, the metallic token turns to translucent glass.

claims.text: Holding the glass owner token, Fang Yuan can enter the treasure room freely, with no need for a high grade evaluation. That hold is equivalent to control of a small part of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. He can stay or leave according to his will. Activating it and making it recognize him is even more difficult than refining a rank five Gu. A slight shake of the token and he disappears from the spot.

He has seen Hei Lou Lan’s owner token and knows at once that this one is greatly different from that original. Close to a millennium earlier, central continent Gu Immortals schemed in the dark and bribed that time’s alliance leader. It is rumored that they also used an Immortal Gu. The token then hid inside Eighty-Eight True Yang Building as a key for later use. In this life it lands in Fang Yuan’s hand.
When Hei Lou Lan’s group is defeated and sent out of the tower, Fang Yuan uses the glass owner token to leave as well, so he does not attract suspicion.

Without a loophole he cannot refine the glass owner token into a one-edge owner token by the earlier plan. Mo Yao has him throw the glass owner token into an ink transformation whirlpool on a flaw. After the inky liquid is spent, a new token flies out with a sharp protrusion like a horn on the edge, which he names a one-edge owner token. Each such flaw, after ink transformation, can advance this token by one edge.

What central continent’s Gu Immortals truly relied on was still the glass owner token. This secondary owner token could be considered a divine treasure. Central continent’s forces spent great energy and resources on it, and it is now in Fang Yuan’s possession, already raised to six edges.

The glass owner token is still at six-edges because it is a cheat item and is not authentic. The owner token snatched from Hei Lou Lan has turned from two-edges to four-edges. Central continent’s Gu Immortals invested more heavily than Fang Yuan and used more than ten Immortal Gu to raise their owner token to forty-three edges.
